description:
A Pierce of Life is a Singapore-based premium jewelry brand specialising in handcrafted flatback earrings and accessories. Our pieces are designed for the modern, style-conscious individual — crafted with high-quality materials and presented in thoughtful, luxurious packaging that makes every unboxing memorable.

What makes us different: We obsess over the details — from the precision of our flatback designs to the editorial-quality imagery and premium packaging experience. Our jewelry is minimal, modern, and versatile, designed to be worn every day yet feel special every time. We ship internationally with a strong presence across Asia-Pacific markets.

How affiliates can earn: Earn a commission on every successful sale referred through your unique affiliate link. Our program is straightforward, transparent, and rewarding — the more you share, the more you earn. [Insert your commission %, cookie duration, and payout details here.]

How to promote us: Our products are highly visual and perform exceptionally well on Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and lifestyle blogs. We provide affiliates with marketing assets, product imagery, and exclusive discount codes to share with your audience. Flat lays, styling reels, and unboxing content tend to resonate best with our community.

Other information: We're looking for partners who genuinely align with a minimal luxury aesthetic — jewelry enthusiasts, fashion and lifestyle creators, and beauty bloggers are a great fit. We ship to multiple international markets, so global creators are welcome to apply.
payout_period: Commissions are calculated at end of each month and paid via bank transfer
term_and_condition:
Welcome to A Pierce of Life! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: email@apierceoflife.com.


8. Prohibited Activities

To protect the A Pierce of Life brand and ensure fair promotion, the following activities are strictly prohibited unless we give prior written approval:

  1. Brand Bidding
    Affiliates may not bid on our brand name, trademarks, or domain (including misspellings or variations) in any paid advertising platform (e.g. Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, etc.).

    • No using “A Pierce of Life” or our domain as keywords.
    • No using “A Pierce of Life” or our domain in ad titles, ad copy, or display URLs.

  2. Coupon / Deal / Cashback Sites
    Coupon, cashback, loyalty, and deal aggregator websites are not eligible to participate in our program.

    • Affiliates may not list, upload, or promote our coupons or offers on such sites.
    • Any commissions generated via these traffic sources may be cancelled at our sole discretion.

  3. Browser Extensions & Toolbars
    Browser extensions, plugins, toolbars, or similar technologies that automatically inject, apply, or overwrite coupon codes, or that hijack existing traffic, are strictly prohibited.

    • No auto-injecting affiliate links or coupons on the A Pierce of Life website or checkout.
    • No overwriting other affiliates’ tracking cookies.

  4. Trademark + Discount Keywords
    Affiliates may not target any combination of our brand name or domain with discount-related keywords in SEO or paid ads, including but not limited to:

    • “A Pierce of Life discount”, “A Pierce of Life coupon”, “A Pierce of Life promo code”, “A Pierce of Life voucher”, “A Pierce of Life deals”, “A Pierce of Life free shipping”, etc.
      Any traffic or sales generated from such keywords may be voided and commissions reversed.

  5. Paid Advertising Without Approval
    Affiliates may not run any paid advertising campaigns that direct traffic to our website or use our brand terms without our prior written approval. This includes, but is not limited to:

    • Google Ads / Bing Ads (search, display, shopping)
    • Meta (Facebook, Instagram) ads
    • TikTok, Snapchat, X (Twitter), YouTube, or other ad networks
      If you wish to use paid ads, you must contact us in advance and obtain written permission. We reserve the right to suspend or remove affiliates and cancel commissions for any unauthorized paid advertising.

  6. General Fraudulent or Abusive Practices
    Any fraudulent, deceptive, or abusive behavior (including cookie stuffing, self-referrals, use of bots, fake leads, or misleading claims) is strictly forbidden and may result in immediate removal from the program and forfeiture of unpaid commissions.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to email@apierceoflife.com for support.
